definitions.gloss: performer; cast member; person appearing in a show
definitions.explanation: A person who appears or performs in a TV show, movie, play, or other production.

examples.japanese: {出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}が{紹介|しょうかい}された。
この{映画|えいが}の{出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}は{全員|ぜんいん}{有名|ゆうめい}な{俳優|はいゆう}だ。
examples.english: All the cast members of this movie are famous actors.

examples.japanese: {番組|ばんぐみ}の{出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}がステージに{上|あ}がると、{観客|かんきゃく}から{大|おお}きな{拍手|はくしゅ}が{起|お}きた。
examples.english: When the show's performers came on stage, the audience burst into loud applause.

notes:
{出演者|しゅつえんしゃ} refers to anyone who appears in a performance or production.

FORMS:
{出演|しゅつえん} (appearing, performing) + {者|しゃ} (person)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}を{紹介|しょうかい}する: to introduce the performers
- {出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}{一覧|いちらん}: cast list
- {主|おも}な{出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}: main cast

RELATED WORDS:
- {出演|しゅつえん}: performance, appearance (the act itself)
- {俳優|はいゆう}: actor/actress
- {出場者|しゅつじょうしゃ}: participant, contestant (sports/competitions)
